scenarios.name: items-failure
scenarios.behavior: Refresh the items list while its read fails with 503.
scenarios.expectation: A failed refresh keeps the items already shown and says it failed.
scenarios.limits: One read, one status fault; other failures are not covered.

scenarios.name: items-normal
scenarios.behavior: Open and refresh the items list with no fault.
scenarios.expectation: The items show, and stay after a refresh.
